items.caption: This seal-script-style rendering shows 戶 above 方. The received Shuowen analysis treats 戶 as the semantic element and 方 as the phonetic element, defining 房 as a room beside the main room.
items.alt: Black seal-script-style rendering of 房, with a broad upper 戶-like shape above a lower 方-like shape.
items.selection_reason: The visible structure makes the received component analysis easy to compare with the character. It is a modern vector redraw, not an image of an ancient inscription.

limitations.text: The graphic’s date and relationship to earlier forms are not established here; this rendering represents a Shuowen seal-script style, not a directly inspected ancient artifact. The traditional component analysis is a historical lexicographic account, not independent proof of how the graph was first formed.
方’s phonetic role is supported by reported sound correspondences, but whether it also contributes the meaning ‘side’ remains uncertain.
